description: Show the user a titled Gaurmon card of flyer offers you chose, in your order: your ranking of the week's best deals, or picks from several searches. Pass offerIds from search_offers or compare_items, plus the same `near` so each row names its nearest store. Use it when the user asks to see, list or rank offers you've already found, instead of writing the list out. Adds no new offers.

near.description: Where the shopper is: a Canadian postal code ("M6H 2B6"), an FSA ("M6H"), or "lat,lng".

offerIds.description: Shown in this order, at most 20.

title.description: What the list is, e.g. "Cheapest protein per kg".

name: show_offers
title: Show chosen offers
